title: Reprise
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Solo violin over piano, horns, nylon guitar and a choir -- peaceful but not idle, which is what rebuilding sounds like. Sits above Creator on energy and above Technology! on calm, so it owns the window after a war ends rather than competing for ordinary peacetime. Driven by the post-war signal in Game::currentMood.
